title: Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit
description: The Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit combines a slim, portable design with the practicality of prefilled pods, making it a straightforward choice for everyday vaping. Its button-free operation and compact build keep things simple, while a strong 1500mAh battery provides reliable power throughout the day. The Slim Stick delivers a mouth-to-lung draw that feels smooth, yet satisfying and tactile, with inhale activation meaning you only need to puff to start vaping. A discreet LED indicator and gentle vibration feedback keep you informed of battery status without fuss, and recharging via USB-C takes under two hours (cable sold separately). Each kit includes a 2ml pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, offering up to 600 puffs. Once finished, the pod is replaced in seconds with a fresh cartridge — no refilling, coil changes or maintenance required. Replacement Oxva Slim Stick refill pods are also available separately, giving you the flexibility to continue vaping your favourite flavours conveniently and hassle-free. OXVA Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit Flavours • Kiwi Passion Fruit Tart Kiwi balanced with sweet Passion Fruit. • Watermelon Fresh, delicately sweet Watermelon. • Blueberry Rounded, juicy Blueberry. • Lychee Ice Sweet Lychee sharpened by a cool icy lift. • Lemon Lime Bright Lemon with a sharp Lime twist. • Mint Clean, refreshing Mint blend. With a wide flavour range, quick charging and a fuss-free design, the Oxva Slim Stick is well suited to vapers who want an uncomplicated yet satisfying pod kit they can rely on.
